title: Auditor arrival
passage:
The auditor has arrived earlier than expected.
A. I will meet her at reception.
B. The previous audit report is in the shared folder.
C. It is a newer model.
passageZh:
稽核人員比預期早到了。
A. 我會到接待處迎接她。
B. 上一份稽核報告在共用資料夾裡。
C. 這是較新的型號。
audioScript:

C. It is a newer model.
